method: At least 98% of a >=100 m IGN segment within 2 m of named official line in EPSG:32718; one distinct normalized name; never replace conflicting IGN name. No nearest, polygon or point naming. Separate DOCUMENTED_BANK_REVIEW: exact reviewed IGN/ANA pair, >=90% inside ordered bank markers and >=95% within their 20 m comparison margin, plus manual plan and coordinate-table validation. No propagation to tributaries.
limitation: Crossed names are cartographic matches, not field verification. 2 m is coordinate matching tolerance, not map accuracy. MINAM hydrography and IGN may share Peru Digital origin; not independent confirmations. Segments are not unique quebradas. GeoQuebradas district risk layer has no channel-name field. ANA points and hazard polygons are review evidence only. The reviewed bank exception is not a centreline identity guarantee, legal boundary reconstruction or flood prediction. Its 20 m comparison margin is not nominal map accuracy.
